mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS notice_id , t.notice_keyword , (t.notice_yn = 'true') AS notice_yn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT sys09_name AS notice_keyword , CASE WHEN emp90_notice_keyword IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS notice_yn FROM sys09_code a INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind b ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id AND sys08_kind_cd = 'BizNoticeCode' LEFT JOIN emp90_notice c ON emp90_notice_keyword = sys09_name AND emp90_person_id = #{personId} WHERE sys09_name ILIKE #{searchText} ) t ORDER BY notice_keyword COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp90_notice (emp90_notice_id, emp90_person_id, emp90_notice_keyword, emp90_note) VALUES (f_create_seq(), #{personId}, #{keyword}, null)
